title: No Sound PvP
body:
🛡️ No Sound PvP

Focus on skill — not noise.

No Sound PvP lets you individually control or completely mute every PvP-related sound in Minecraft.
Explosions, eating, totems, potions, pearls, water, lava, footsteps, wind charges — every sound that distracts you during fights can now be silenced or adjusted.

Whether you want total silence or just lower annoying sounds, you have full control.

🖼️ Screenshot

![sounds](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ce483f3146d9a2ae6ceb27886031d97292760fb3.png)

⚙️ Features

🎚️ Individual volume sliders for each PvP sound (0–100).

Explosions

Bow & Crossbow

Eating & Drinking

Normal & Critical hits

Totem activation

Ender Pearls (throw & teleport)

Shield Block & Shield Break

Wind Charge

Block placement

Water & Lava ambience

Footsteps

Mace Smash (new in 1.21!)

🧩 Fully client-side (works on any server).

🖥️ Works seamlessly with ModMenu and Cloth Config.

💡 Set any value:

100 → normal volume

50 → half volume

0 → completely silent

🧱 Dependencies

Fabric API
 (required)

Cloth Config
 (required)

ModMenu
 (optional, for settings menu)

📦 Compatibility

✅ Minecraft 1.21.x

🧩 Fabric Loader 0.15+

Works with any PvP modpack — purely client-side, no server installation needed.

💬 Why use it?

Because PvP is about reaction and precision — not sound spam.
Mute distractions like explosions, pearls, or totems, and keep your focus sharp.

🧑‍💻 Author

Created by Varlock
